div.head: Iud Dei III 1.2
div.ab: Fac eum, Domine, in uisceribus angustari eiusque guttur conclude, ut panem uel caseum istum in tuo nomine sanctificatum deuorare non possit hic qui iniuste iurauit ac negauit illud furtum — uel homicidium aut adulterium seu maleficium — quod quaerebatur, et iusiurandum pro nihilo habuit et nomen tuum nominauit, ubi rectum non erat.
div.note: New row (October 2026): Liebermann’s text transcribed from Gesetze I p. 408 (two independent readings of the page images, differences settled against the page)

div.ab: Make him, O Lord, to be constricted in his entrails, and close up his throat, so that this bread or cheese, sanctified in your name, he may not be able to devour, he who has unjustly sworn and denied that theft — or homicide or adultery or sorcery — which was being inquired into, and has held the oath as nothing, and has named your name where it was not right.
